Products represent catalog items; variants represent combinations such as size or flavor, with their
own identifiers and inventory relationships. Do not infer stock from title alone.
Product එක chocolate වJගේ item එකකේ. Variant එක flavor Jහහෝ size වJගේ option combination
එකකේ. Stock එක අදොළ inventory data අනුව බලන්න.
